# Unilever Enhances Global Security and Achieves “Just Enough” Access to Apps with Zero Trust

> Zscaler enables Unilever to eliminate VPNs, provide users with secure direct connectivity to apps and the internet, and streamline access across 190 countries

**Customer Name:** Unilever

### Key Metrics
- **3B+**: transactions secured weekly
- **99.9%**: uptime while processing 220TB of data in two months
- **1,500+**: applications managed with “just enough” zero trust access

## Customer Snapshot
- **Title:** Unilever
- **Description:** Global consumer goods company with products used by 3.4 billion people daily
- **Industry:** Manufacturing
- **Headquarters:** London, UK
- **Size:** Sales across 190 countries

## Executive Summary
### Challenges
- Legacy VPNs had limited flexibility and could not scale with Unilever’s global cloud strategy
- Traditional security model increased risk due to insufficient access control and visibility
- Rising demand for remote access strained the VPN infrastructure, impacting the user experience

### Results & Impact
- Reduces risk with secure, direct access to applications and without the limitations and vulnerabilities of VPN
- Enhances operational efficiency by processing large-scale data traffic with 99.99% uptime
- Supports global cloud strategy by providing secure remote access across 190 countries, maintaining flexibility for Unilever’s workforce

## Featured Quotes
> "Zscaler’s zero trust approach has transformed security at Unilever. Eliminating VPN bottlenecks allows our global workforce to securely access applications, enhancing performance, flexibility, and resilience."
> — **Richard Mardling — Access and Connectivity Director — Unilever**

> "With Zscaler, Unilever has achieved seamless, secure access to applications globally, empowering our teams to work efficiently from anywhere."
> — **Richard Mardling — Access and Connectivity Director — Unilever**

> "Transitioning to Zscaler allowed us to replace legacy VPNs, giving Unilever flexibility and scalability for our cloud-first strategy."
> — **Richard Mardling — Access and Connectivity Director — Unilever**

> "Zscaler’s zero trust approach enhances Unilever’s security by ensuring that only the right people have access to the right applications, globally."
> — **Richard Mardling — Access and Connectivity Director — Unilever**
